samples.question: This page carries five coloured plates - one red, one orange, one green, one blue and one purple - together with many grey plates. Only the five coloured plates decide the answer; grey plates are decoration and never count. Each plate is a solid slab with one or more square windows punched right through it, so that the page shows through each window; a window is fully surrounded by its own plate and never touches the edge of that plate. Count the windows of each coloured plate. Exactly four of the five coloured plates split into two pairs whose two members have equally many windows, and exactly one coloured plate has a window count matching no other coloured plate; call that plate the unpaired plate. Plate size, plate position and total ink are irrelevant. Which colour is the unpaired plate? Answer red, orange, green, blue, or purple.
